name: event-management-system
description: Enterprise Event Management Platform - MERN Stack

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install

author: Antigravity Engineering Team
